description: This file defines the KeyIdMap class, which manages a thread-safe mapping between session IDs and key IDs within the Rialto client component. It provides methods to add, update, retrieve, and erase key session data, and uses mutex for synchronization.

classes.name: KeyIdMap
classes.description: Manages a thread-safe map of session IDs to key IDs, implemented as a singleton.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of KeyIdMap.

methods.name: addSession
methods.description: Adds a new session ID to the map.

methods.name: updateKey
methods.description: Updates the key ID associated with a session ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the key ID associated with a session ID.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes a session ID and its associated key ID from the map.
